description: This file declares string formatting utility functions (StringPrintf, StringAppendF, StringAppendV) in the android::base namespace, which are wrappers around vsnprintf for creating and manipulating formatted strings.

methods.name: StringPrintf
methods.description: Returns a formatted string similar to printf with variable arguments.

methods.name: StringAppendF
methods.description: Appends a formatted string to an existing std::string.

methods.name: StringAppendV
methods.description: Appends a formatted string with va_list arguments to an existing std::string.
